title: The Workbench on a Real Repo — Choosing a Pilot Repository

title: The Workbench on a Real Repo — Installing and Adapting

objectives: Fill the instruction file with real commands.

title: The Workbench on a Real Repo — Running and Reporting the Pilot
titleKn: ನಿಜ ರೆಪೊದಲ್ಲಿ Workbench — ಪೈಲಟ್ ಚಾಲನೆ ಮತ್ತು ವರದಿ
desc: Run the task set, record the outcomes and write an honest report of what the workbench changed.
objectives: Record success, retries and human edits.
Report failures as candidly as successes.
